items_flat.title_en: Over 1,100 AI Lab Staff Petition U.S. Government to Support Tools for Deliberately Pacing Frontier AI
items_flat.title_zh: 超過1,100名AI實驗室員工聯署，要求美國政府支持可刻意調節前沿AI發展的工具
items_flat.summary_en: More than 1,100 researchers and staff from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and other labs signed the “Pacing the Frontier” petition calling on the U.S. government to support an international effort to develop technical and governance tools that could deliberately pace frontier AI development if needed. OpenAI and Anthropic publicly endorsed the call on X.
items_flat.summary_zh: 來自OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta等實驗室的超過1,100名研究人員與員工簽署「Pacing the Frontier」請願書，呼籲美國政府支持國際合作，開發必要時可刻意調節前沿AI發展的技術與治理工具。OpenAI與Anthropic已在X公開表態支持。
items_flat.analysis_en: The petition is notable for cross-lab consensus on the need for optional pacing mechanisms rather than an immediate pause. Whether governments build the requested tools, and how competitive dynamics interact with any future slowdown capability, remains the central uncertainty.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 請願書的重要性在於跨實驗室對「可選調節機制」（而非立即暫停）的共識。政府是否建立所要求的工具，以及競爭動態如何與未來減速能力互動，仍是核心不確定性。
items_flat.quote: We request that the U.S. government support an international effort to develop the technical and governance tools needed to deliberately pace the frontier of automated AI development.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們請求美國政府支持國際努力，開發可刻意調節自動化AI發展前沿所需的技術與治理工具。

items_flat.title_en: xAI Introduces Build Mode for Creating Apps, Games and Dashboards with Grok
items_flat.title_zh: xAI推出Build Mode，讓Grok直接打造App、遊戲與儀表板
items_flat.summary_en: xAI announced Build Mode, now in early beta for SuperGrok Heavy subscribers on web, iOS and Android. Users describe an idea and Grok builds a working website, app, game or interactive dashboard live in the chat, then publishes it to a shareable grok.me link or custom domain.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI宣布Build Mode進入早期測試，開放給SuperGrok Heavy訂閱用戶（網頁、iOS、Android）。使用者描述想法後，Grok即時在對話中建構可用的網站、App、遊戲或互動儀表板，並可發布至可分享的grok.me連結或自有網域。
items_flat.analysis_en: This further collapses the distance between idea and functional software, keeping the entire creation loop inside Grok’s ecosystem. Real production robustness and long-term maintainability remain open questions for anything beyond prototypes.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉進一步縮短「想法」與「可用軟體」的距離，並把完整創作循環鎖在Grok生態系內。除原型外，實際生產環境的穩健性與長期維護仍是未知數。
items_flat.quote: Tell Grok an idea, and it builds a working version live in your chat... When it's ready, publish it to a link anyone can open.
items_flat.quote_zh: 告訴Grok一個想法，它就會在對話中即時建構可用版本……完成後可發布成任何人都能開啟的連結。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA-Led Open Secure AI Alliance Expands with 40+ Partners Including xAI, Microsoft and Hugging Face
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA主導的Open Secure AI Alliance擴大至40+夥伴，含xAI、Microsoft與Hugging Face
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA’s Open Secure AI Alliance, launched 27 July and further promoted on 28 July, brings together more than 40 organizations (including SpaceXAI/xAI, Microsoft, Hugging Face, Mistral, IBM, Linux Foundation and others) to develop open tools, models and harnesses for AI cybersecurity. NVIDIA is contributing open models, weights, data and the new NOOA agent framework.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA於7月27日啟動、28日持續推廣的Open Secure AI Alliance已集結超過40個組織（含SpaceXAI/xAI、Microsoft、Hugging Face、Mistral、IBM、Linux Foundation等），共同開發AI網路安全用的開源工具、模型與harness。NVIDIA貢獻開源模型、權重、資料與新NOOA agent框架。
items_flat.analysis_en: The alliance frames open models and tooling as defensive assets in the wake of recent closed-model sandbox incidents. Its long-term effectiveness will depend on concrete shared artifacts and whether major closed labs eventually join.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 聯盟將開源模型與工具定位為防禦資產，回應近期封閉模型沙盒事件。長期成效取決於實際共享產出，以及主要封閉實驗室是否最終加入。
items_flat.quote: AI security advances when the industry builds in the open, together.
items_flat.quote_zh: AI安全的進展，來自產業一起公開建構。

links.label: NVIDIA Blog – Open Secure AI Alliance

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic’s Claude Mythos Preview Discovers Cryptographic Weaknesses in HAWK and Reduced-Round AES
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic的Claude Mythos Preview發現HAWK與弱化AES的密碼弱點
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team reported that Claude Mythos Preview found an improved key-recovery attack on HAWK (a NIST post-quantum signature candidate), cutting effective key strength roughly in half (e.g., HAWK-256 from 2^64 to 2^38), and a new “Möbius Bridge” technique that speeds prior attacks on 7-round AES by 200-800×. Neither result affects production systems.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic前沿紅隊報告，Claude Mythos Preview發現對HAWK（NIST後量子簽名候選）的改進金鑰恢復攻擊，有效金鑰強度約減半（如HAWK-256從2^64降至2^38），以及名為「Möbius Bridge」的新技術，使7輪AES既有攻擊加速200-800倍。兩項結果皆不影響現有生產系統。
items_flat.analysis_en: The results demonstrate that frontier models can already perform expert-level cryptanalysis that previously required human specialists and years of review. They strengthen the case for rigorous pre-standardization testing while remaining carefully scoped away from deployed systems.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 結果顯示前沿模型已能執行過去需人類專家與多年審查的專家級密碼分析。這強化了標準化前嚴格測試的必要性，同時研究範圍謹慎避開已部署系統。
items_flat.quote: Mythos was able to improve the best-known attack on it in just 60 hours of work—effectively cutting its key strength in half.
items_flat.quote_zh: Mythos僅用60小時工作就改進了已知最佳攻擊——有效將其金鑰強度減半。

items_flat.title_en: Grok 4.5 Now Available in GitHub Copilot
items_flat.summary_en: xAI announced that Grok 4.5 is rolling out in GitHub Copilot for Pro, Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise users. It supports up to 500k-token context, text+image inputs and adjustable reasoning effort, selectable from the model picker in VS Code, Copilot CLI, cloud agents and other IDEs.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI宣布Grok 4.5已開始在GitHub Copilot上線，開放給Pro、Pro+、Max、Business與Enterprise用戶。支援最高50萬token上下文、文字+圖像輸入與可調推理強度，可在VS Code、Copilot CLI、雲端agent及其他IDE的模型選擇器中選用。
items_flat.analysis_en: The integration puts a competitively priced frontier coding model directly into the daily workflow of millions of developers, intensifying pressure on other model providers inside the dominant coding platform.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此整合把價格具競爭力的前沿編碼模型直接放進數百萬開發者的日常工作流，加劇其他模型供應商在主流編碼平台上的壓力。
items_flat.quote: Grok 4.5, our smartest coding model, is now available in GitHub Copilot.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們最強的編碼模型Grok 4.5現已在GitHub Copilot中可用。

links.label: xAI Blog – Grok 4.5 in GitHub Copilot

items_flat.title_en: Elon Musk Teases Grok 4.6 (1.5T) Around August 7 and Grok 4.7 (2.1T) Weeks Later
items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克預告Grok 4.6（1.5T）約8月7日、Grok 4.7（2.1T）數週後登場
items_flat.summary_en: In an X post, Elon Musk stated that Grok 4.6 (1.5T model with significantly improved SFT & RL) is expected around August 7, followed a few weeks later by Grok 4.7 (2.1T model that is better in every way except slightly slower to serve, with even better token efficiency).
items_flat.summary_zh: 馬斯克在X發文表示，Grok 4.6（1.5T模型，SFT與RL大幅改進）預計約8月7日推出，數週後再推出Grok 4.7（2.1T模型，各方面更優、僅服務速度略慢，但token效率更高）。
items_flat.analysis_en: The rapid cadence continues xAI’s monthly-foundation-model strategy and keeps competitive pressure on closed rivals. Exact performance gains, pricing and public availability details remain unconfirmed.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 快速迭代延續xAI每月基礎模型策略，持續對封閉模型對手施壓。實際效能提升、定價與公開可用性細節仍未確認。
items_flat.quote: Grok 4.6 releases around August 7. This will be the 1.5T model with significantly improved SFT & RL. Grok 4.7 will be the 2.1T model released a few weeks later.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok 4.6約8月7日發布。這會是1.5T模型，SFT與RL大幅改進。Grok 4.7將是幾週後發布的2.1T模型。

items_flat.title_en: Meta and BlackRock Announce $14B 1GW Data-Center Venture in El Paso for AI
items_flat.title_zh: Meta與BlackRock宣布140億美元、1GW El Paso資料中心合資案
items_flat.summary_en: Meta and BlackRock announced a joint venture to develop and own a 1-gigawatt data-center campus in El Paso, Texas, with total development costs of approximately $14 billion. BlackRock funds will hold 80% ownership and Meta 20%; the facility is already under construction and expected online from 2028, with Meta as initial sole occupant.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta與BlackRock宣布合資開發並擁有德州El Paso一座1GW資料中心園區，總開發成本約140億美元。BlackRock基金持有80%股權、Meta保留20%；設施已在興建，預計2028年起上線，Meta為初期唯一佔用者。
items_flat.analysis_en: The deal underscores the capital intensity of frontier AI compute and Meta’s willingness to share ownership to accelerate capacity. Actual GPU deployment timelines and power-sourcing details will determine competitive impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 交易凸顯前沿AI算力的資本密集度，以及Meta願意分享所有權以加速產能。實際GPU部署時程與電力來源細節將決定競爭影響。
items_flat.quote: Funds managed by BlackRock will own an 80% interest in the venture, while Meta will retain the remaining 20% ownership.
items_flat.quote_zh: BlackRock管理的基金將持有合資事業80%權益，Meta保留剩餘20%所有權。

items_flat.title_en: Meta Signs EU AI Act Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content
items_flat.title_zh: Meta簽署歐盟AI法《AI生成內容透明度實務守則》
items_flat.summary_en: Meta announced it is signing the EU AI Act Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content. The move builds on Meta’s existing labeling work since 2024 and industry efforts such as C2PA, aiming for practical, interoperable identification of synthetic media.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta宣布簽署歐盟AI法《AI生成內容透明度實務守則》。此舉延續Meta自2024年起的標記工作，並與C2PA等產業努力接軌，目標是實用且可互通的合成媒體識別方式。
items_flat.analysis_en: Signing signals proactive regulatory alignment in Europe while Meta continues to emphasize that transparency must remain usable rather than purely compliance-driven. Implementation quality and label proliferation risks remain to be tested after the 2 August 2026 obligations take effect.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 簽署顯示Meta在歐洲採取主動監管對齊，同時持續強調透明度必須可用而非純粹合規。2026年8月2日義務生效後，執行品質與標籤氾濫風險仍待觀察。
items_flat.quote: Signing the EU AI Act Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content... reflects our commitment to this principle.
items_flat.quote_zh: 簽署歐盟AI法《AI生成內容透明度實務守則》……反映我們對此原則的承諾。

frontier_other.title_en: NVIDIA-Led Open Secure AI Alliance Expands with 40+ Partners Including xAI, Microsoft and Hugging Face
frontier_other.title_zh: NVIDIA主導的Open Secure AI Alliance擴大至40+夥伴，含xAI、Microsoft與Hugging Face
frontier_other.summary_en: NVIDIA’s Open Secure AI Alliance, launched 27 July and further promoted on 28 July, brings together more than 40 organizations (including SpaceXAI/xAI, Microsoft, Hugging Face, Mistral, IBM, Linux Foundation and others) to develop open tools, models and harnesses for AI cybersecurity. NVIDIA is contributing open models, weights, data and the new NOOA agent framework.
frontier_other.summary_zh: NVIDIA於7月27日啟動、28日持續推廣的Open Secure AI Alliance已集結超過40個組織（含SpaceXAI/xAI、Microsoft、Hugging Face、Mistral、IBM、Linux Foundation等），共同開發AI網路安全用的開源工具、模型與harness。NVIDIA貢獻開源模型、權重、資料與新NOOA agent框架。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The alliance frames open models and tooling as defensive assets in the wake of recent closed-model sandbox incidents. Its long-term effectiveness will depend on concrete shared artifacts and whether major closed labs eventually join.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 聯盟將開源模型與工具定位為防禦資產，回應近期封閉模型沙盒事件。長期成效取決於實際共享產出，以及主要封閉實驗室是否最終加入。
frontier_other.quote: AI security advances when the industry builds in the open, together.
frontier_other.quote_zh: AI安全的進展，來自產業一起公開建構。

links.label: NVIDIA Blog – Open Secure AI Alliance

brief_en: xAI shipped Build Mode and Grok 4.5 in GitHub Copilot while Musk teased Grok 4.6/4.7; NVIDIA’s Open Secure AI Alliance grew; Meta closed a $14B El Paso data-center JV with BlackRock and signed the EU AI transparency code; Anthropic’s Claude Mythos Preview found crypto weaknesses; >1,100 staff across labs petitioned for tools to deliberately pace frontier AI.
brief_zh: xAI推出Build Mode與Grok 4.5進GitHub Copilot，馬斯克預告Grok 4.6/4.7；NVIDIA開源安全AI聯盟擴大；Meta與BlackRock成立140億美元El Paso資料中心合資並簽署歐盟AI透明守則；Anthropic Claude Mythos Preview發現密碼弱點；超過1,100名跨廠員工聯署要求建立可刻意調節前沿AI發展的工具。
